data.name: Bulls and Cows: The Summoning
data.shortDescription: Summon a demon by guessing its secret sigil. Each try tells you how many symbols are right and in place, and how many are right but misplaced. No attempt limit, but speed counts.

cardImage.alt: A dark summoning ritual with a shadowy demon standing inside a glowing red pentagram, surrounded by darkness and eerie crimson light.

data.name: Moosweep
data.shortDescription: You're a gourmet cow on a 9x9 field. Eat all the grass you can, but watch out for the mines. Your sensitive nose tells you how many are nearby.

cardImage.alt: A cute brown-and-white cow standing in a fenced grassy field filled with small plants and yellow flowers.A cute brown-and-white cow standing in a fenced grassy field filled with small plants and yellow flowers.

data.name: Minesweeper
data.shortDescription: The classic mine-clearing puzzle. Open cells, read the numbers, flag the suspicious ones and try not to blow up. One wrong click and it's over.

cardImage.alt: A classic minesweeper game with a grid of covered and revealed cells, numbered clues and flags marking suspected mines on a dark background.

data.name: RSS CSS Selectors
data.shortDescription: A little trainer for CSS selectors. Some elements on the table pulse, you write a selector that hits exactly those. Stuck? There's a Help button that types the answer for you.

cardImage.alt: A CSS selector learning game featuring cute animals resting on plates, with a colorful title banner and illustrated cats and capybaras.

data.name: Pair 'em Up
data.shortDescription: A number-matching puzzle on a 9-column grid. Remove pairs that are equal or add up to 10 and reach 100 points before you run out of moves and helpers.

cardImage.alt: A neon number-matching puzzle with a glowing grid of numbers, two highlighted cells and a dark background.

data.name: Forest Guardians
data.shortDescription: A small tactical game about saving a forest from spreading fire. Start with one scout squirrel, find the towns, hire helpers and put the flames out. Coming soon.

cardImage.alt: A forest wildlife scene with a squirrel, turtle and hedgehog near a pond, surrounded by burning trees and a wildfire spreading through the woodland toward a distant castle.

data.name: Memory Game: Neither This Nor That
data.shortDescription: A vegetable dark fantasy memory game. Eight princes court a princess, she rejects every pair you find and eats them. The last one left wins her hand.

cardImage.alt: A dark fantasy illustration of a crowned vegetable princess holding a scepter, surrounded by eerie botanical decorations, moon imagery and gothic ornamental artwork.

data.name: Virtual Music Kit
data.shortDescription: Play a virtual instrument with your mouse or keyboard. Seven sounds, keys you can rebind, and a sequence field to play whole melodies automatically.

cardImage.alt: A stylized kalimba with colorful wooden tines arranged in a row, ready to be played as a virtual musical instrument

data.name: Pumpkin Patch Days
data.shortDescription: A slow little farm game about growing pumpkins. Plant, water, wait for the weather to behave, and turn your harvest into soups and pies for the village fair.

cardImage.alt: A farmer harvesting a large pumpkin in an autumn field, surrounded by smaller pumpkins, a wooden cart full of produce and golden countryside hills

data.name: Lantern Moth
data.shortDescription: Play as a tiny moth carrying a lantern through a dark forest. Follow the light, wake sleeping fireflies and find the way back to the old oak.

cardImage.alt: A glowing moth carrying a lantern in a dark enchanted forest, surrounded by twisted tree roots, tiny mushrooms and magical lights
